title: Re-certify sync reliability guards against the current durable-worker architecture

acceptanceCriteria.description: The PS-272 closeout guard follows the current one-confirmation fulfillment bound and shipment order-priority delegation instead of stale pre-refactor source text.
The connection-owner audit permits only the current explicit pools and separately proves that stuck-job recovery and worker telemetry remain isolated one-connection control-plane clients.
Rate workflow reservation proof follows the PS-428 durable unique active-request fence and conflict convergence rather than the removed session advisory-lock implementation.
Multi-instance deferral evidence tolerates formatting while still requiring exact durable rate payload and deferral metadata preservation.
The mandatory source-of-truth pack, strict typecheck, production web build, API/readiness contracts, and security readiness suite pass with the guard updates.

The implementation is offline test maintenance only and does not change runtime sync behavior, provider calls, labels, postage, marketplace notifications, migrations, or protected shipped/cancelled data.

wrappers.delegatesTo: the explicit runtime pool constructors and their one-connection invariants

sotBypass.details: Only evidence guards changed. Each assertion points at the current runtime or migration owner; no guard introduces business truth, no alternate sync state is created, and no product caller changes.

evidence.proves: The canonical closure evaluator and complete governance fixture pass offline.
Wrong-SHA, wrong-branch, static-only, source-of-truth bypass, and unsupported-score packets are rejected or capped.
Injected malformed, stale-identity, missing-tier, and unverified-live evidence cannot produce a false green.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-272-bounded-sync-closeout && npm run test:ps-272-bounded-sync
evidence.proves: The closeout and focused guards agree on current service-owned page/time limits, one-confirmation outbox work, and shipment priority delegation.
Every runtime postgres constructor is explicitly allowlisted, while recovery and telemetry pools are separately constrained to one connection.
Queue lane locking remains isolated and rate reservation uses durable uniqueness plus conflict convergence without a session-held rate lock.
PostgreSQL-compatible integration proves the active-request uniqueness and durable worker generation fences.
Durable rate payload preservation and concurrent best-rate ratchet behavior pass against the current multi-instance implementation.
All 48 mandatory source-of-truth and architecture guards pass in one uninterrupted run.
Backend and frontend strict TypeScript checks pass.
The production frontend bundle builds successfully.

evidence.command: npm run test:api-contracts && npm run test:health-deep-readiness
evidence.proves: API contract and deep-health readiness guards remain green.
The complete authentication, RBAC, tenant-scope, redaction, dependency-policy, RLS, audit, privacy, and session security suite passes.
The reviewed implementation commit changes only four offline evidence guards and touches no runtime, frontend, migration, provider adapter, or protected shipped/cancelled file.

verification.command: No migrations were added or modified; not applicable.

migrations.rollbackPlan: Revert the packet-only commit, then revert b896242d3ac116ab46ea5183c9f1aabef761b0ff; no schema or production-data rollback is required.

rollback.strategy: Revert the packet-only commit and implementation commit. This restores the previous offline assertions and changes no runtime or data state.

liveVerification.reason: The implementation changes offline evidence guards only. It does not invoke providers, purchase labels or postage, notify marketplaces, write a production database, or mutate shipped/cancelled data.
